scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker "npm run dev --workspace @app/web" "npm run dev --workspace @app/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @app/worker && npm run build --workspace @app/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.db:recreate: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @pkg/shared && npm run build --workspace @pkg/db
scripts.test:ping-route: npm run build:packages && tsx --tsconfig apps/web/tsconfig.json --test tests/ping-route.test.mjs
scripts.test:sync: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @app/worker && node scripts/test-strava.mjs sync
scripts.test:training: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test-strava.mjs training
scripts.test:planner: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test-strava.mjs planner
scripts.test:health: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test-strava.mjs health
scripts.test:calendar: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test-strava.mjs calendar
scripts.test:planning: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test-strava.mjs planning
scripts.test:adaptive: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test-strava.mjs adaptive
scripts.test:semantics: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test-strava.mjs semantics
scripts.evaluate:planner:openai: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @app/worker && node scripts/evaluate-planner.mjs --openai
scripts.test:openai: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test-strava.mjs openai
scripts.test:settings: npm run build:packages && node scripts/test-strava.mjs settings
